messages:
Eve-Lee: Quick Friday note — thank you for the focus this week. High level: private-beta is green, cost per token trending down 8% MoM, but we still have a latency tail at p95 on long-contexts.
Samir: Great work. Two asks: 1) prioritize the quantization rollout for the recommendation traffic, 2) push a short eval set for logging edge cases by EOD Monday.
Jordan: On quantization — infra prep looks good. We'll schedule canary on Dedicated tonight 22:00 UTC. Ops will get the rollback script.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled by @eng-oncall: canary-quant-v2 -> prod at 22:00 UTC. CI checks: passed. If error rate > 1% auto-rollback.
Lila: Heads up on people ops — hiring freeze lifted for senior infra roles; approvals should route via me for rapid interviews. Also remind managers to complete Q1 calibrations.
Eve-Lee: Incident summary: small GPU OOM cluster last week — thanks to Jordan & SRE for quick mitigation. Follow-ups: implement KV cache size guardrail and an alert for cache-growth > 20% in 10m.
Jordan: Adding the guardrail today. Patch PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/kv-guard/PR-432. Will post rollout window in #eng-runtime.
Samir: Product priorities next week: 1) finish model pin for Private GA, 2) roll out streaming fixes for multi-turn, 3) start partner onboarding playbook draft (Samir + Lila).
Eve-Lee: SLA ask — ops and eng to align on p99 lat SLO for Hosted by Tuesday. If not achievable, propose temporary admission control and update Console messaging.
Jordan: Acknowledged. We'll run a 3hr stress test on Monday 02:00-05:00 UTC to validate. I'll post the heatmap and p99 delta.
Lila: People ops will prep a short comms template for the admission control messaging so Customer Success can reuse it.
Eve-Lee: Final: thanks team. Small wins this week, clear work ahead. Please surface blockers early. :heart:
